prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: is it possible to book a flight with a combination of gift cards, skymiles, and money?
Delta: Hi Cory, you would be able to use SkyMiles and pay for the taxes with either a gift card or a credit card but not both. *TLT

Customer: Loving you Delta! We got $2350 in cash gift cards, 20k miles, 6 meals, hotel with shuttle just to fly tomorrow! Xoxo
Delta: Wow! Very nice and we thank you for being our customer.  *HRO

Customer: you guys have been awesome. Short trip from MSP->DEN and back and we’ve been blessed with gift cards, FC, priority boarding, & DC+😁👍🏼
Delta: Awesome, thank you for flying with us. *AMS

Customer: Jacob Thompson doesn't have much time and wants Christmas cards. I had people sign all 64 cards, Lets see how many we can send him https://t.co/hJtFxwAt6P
Delta: Thanks for sharing, Anthony! Please share mailing details via DM!  *HDG

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: other):
"""DO NOT BUY DELTA GIFT CARDS AT MERCHANTS BECAUSE DELTA WON'T HONOR THEM FOR 3 DAYS EVEN THOUGH THEY ARE LEGAL AND ACTIVATED"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry you’ve had this experience. Please DM us with the card details so we can look into it for you.
